1	"""Rolling median over a fixed window."""
2	import bisect
3	from collections import deque
4	
5	
6	class RollingMedian:
7	    def __init__(self, window):
8	        self.window = window
9	        self.buf = deque()
10	        self.sorted = []
11	
12	    def push(self, x):
13	        if len(self.buf) == self.window:
14	            old = self.buf.popleft()
15	            i = bisect.bisect_left(self.sorted, old)
16	            self.sorted.pop(i)
17	        self.buf.append(x)
18	        bisect.insort(self.sorted, x)
19	
20	    def value(self):
21	        n = len(self.sorted)
22	        if n == 0:
23	            return None
24	        mid = n // 2
25	        if n % 2:
26	            return self.sorted[mid]
27	        return (self.sorted[mid - 1] + self.sorted[mid]) / 2

2	import time

5	class TokenBucket:
6	    def __init__(self, capacity, refill_per_sec):
7	        self.capacity = capacity
8	        self.refill = refill_per_sec
9	        self.tokens = float(capacity)
10	        self.last = time.monotonic()
11	
12	    def _refill(self):
13	        now = time.monotonic()
14	        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.last) * self.refill)
15	        self.last = now
16	
17	    def take(self, n=1):
18	        self._refill()
19	        if self.tokens >= n:
20	            self.tokens -= n
21	            return True
22	        return False
23	
24	    def wait_time(self, n=1):
25	        self._refill()
26	        if self.tokens >= n:
27	            return 0.0
28	        return (n - self.tokens) / self.refill
